name: Jolanda di Savoia (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Jolanda di Savoia (wheat ears on red and a rising sun over fields on light blue).
history: Municipal flag of Jolanda di Savoia, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Jolanda di Savoia arms — wheat ears on red and a rising sun over fields, crowned
